Force Converter

Convert between newtons, kilonewtons, pounds-force, kilograms-force, dynes and ounces-force with exact factors.

UnitValue

Factors: 1 lbf = 4.4482216152605 N, 1 kgf = 9.80665 N, 1 dyn = 10−5 N, 1 ozf = lbf/16.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter a force value in the first field.
  2. Pick the unit you are converting from.
  3. Read the value converted to every other unit in the table.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many newtons are in a pound-force?

1 lbf = 4.4482216152605 N exactly (defined by the international avoirdupois pound, 0.45359237 kg, times standard gravity 9.80665 m/s²).

Are kgf and dyn exact?

Yes. 1 kgf is defined as exactly 9.80665 N, and 1 dyn is defined as exactly 1e-5 N (the CGS unit of force).

What is the difference between kgf and kg?

Force is mass times acceleration. kgf measures weight (mass × standard gravity), while kg is mass. The converter treats 1 kgf = 9.80665 N under standard gravity.
